acceptanceCriteria: Impact on a Ruby repo with a Gemfile and spec/ (or .rspec) lists bundle exec rspec and drops the no-language-specific-verification line
Affected advice lists an advisory rspec check over the selected spec files
No command is offered without a Gemfile
Go and web verification plans are byte-unchanged; spec requirements and tests added
body: GitHub #1130 item 4. toolchainCommand in contextindex/receipt.go has Go, Python and web branches only, so impact on Ruby reports 'no language-specific verification command is known for this repository' and affected advice is checks: [] with NO_ADVISORY_GO_COMMAND.
title: GH #1130 S3: known Ruby verification command (bundle exec rspec) in impact and affected advice
